snippet.title: Shatterlight gameplay trailer new
snippet.description:
Shatterlight is a survival horror platformer.
You play as Agnes, trapped inside a Victorian mansion consumed by the Dark World — a place where fears take physical form. Armed with a shard of a broken mirror, she confronts living darkness, uncovers the tragedy of a vanished family, and searches for her missing brother.
